title: Madona’s home – level 1
paragraphs: Famous singer Madonna shows Vogue her house in London. She has many special things there. She loves them.

First, she shows a famous painting by Frida Kahlo. She buys it after moving to New York. She also shows things from her family, like her mother’s wooden rosary and a sculpture by her son. Her daughter makes her a warm blanket during COVID quarantine.
In her bedroom, Madonna showsher favorite books and a toy octopus named Octavia. A nurse helps Madonna in the hospital. The toy makes her think of that nurse.
